items.title: 49ers likely won't cut Brandon Aiyuk until they have to
items.text: With a roster exemption that lasts until November 24 and with no requirement to pay him a penny until the exemption expires, the 49ers have shown no inclination to release receiver Brandon Aiyuk until they absolutely have to.

items.title: For the Seahawks this year, Drew Lock's numbers blow Sam Darnold's away
items.text: When Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald confirmed that Sam Darnold will start in Week 12 against the 49ers, assuming he is medically cleared, it was no surprise: The Seahawks signed Darnold to a three-year, $100 million contract last year and won the Super Bowl with Darnold at the helm.
